# secobserve_branch (List Resource)

Lists the branches of one SecObserve product. Terraform stops after 100 results unless the `list` block sets `limit`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Emits import blocks and configuration for the branches of one product.
list "secobserve_branch" "all" {
  provider = secobserve

  config {
    # A .tfquery.hcl cannot reference resources; use the product id.
    product = 12
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `product` (Number) Id of the product whose objects to list.
